message.title: Subsea7 awarded contract offshore Norway
message.body:
Luxembourg - 2 November 2026 - Subsea 7 S.A. (Oslo Børs: SUBC, ADR: SUBCY) today
announced  the award of  a substantial1 contract  by Aker BP  for the Lyra field
development  project, formerly known as Kjøttkake,  located in the northern part
of  the North Sea,  approximately 44 kilometres from  the Gjøa platform offshore
Norway.

The  Lyra field  development will  be tied  back to  the existing  Gjøa platform
through the NOVA field infrastructure.

Subsea7's scope includes engineering, procurement, construction and installation
(EPCI)   of   gas   lift   and   production   pipelines  and  associated  subsea
infrastructure.  The production pipeline will  feature a pipe-in-pipe design and
offshore  installation activities will be  executed using vessels from Subsea7's
fleet.

Project  management  and  engineering  activities  will  commence immediately at
Subsea7's  office in Stavanger, Norway. Pipeline  fabrication will take place at
Subsea7's  spool base  at Vigra,  Norway. Offshore  operations are scheduled for
execution during 2026, 2027 and 2028.

Lyra  is a fast-track development targeting  first oil in 2028, only three years
after  discovery. To  enable the  accelerated schedule,  Subsea7 received a pre-
commitment     for     critical    long-lead    items    in    December    2025
(https://newsweb.oslobors.no/message/662568).

Erik  Femsteinevik, Vice President Norway at  Subsea7, said: "Lyra showcases the
strength  of the  Aker BP Subsea  Alliance(2). From  securing long-lead items to
mobilising   engineering,   fabrication   and  offshore  resources,  this  award
demonstrates Subsea7's ability to deliver first production at exceptional speed.
We  are excited to support Aker BP  on another landmark development and proud to
bring  the expertise  of our  Stavanger and  Vigra teams  to a project that will
deliver significant value for our client, partners and the Norwegian Continental
Shelf."

 1. Subsea7 defines a substantial contract as being between $150 million and
    $300 million.
 2. The Aker BP Subsea Alliance is a partnership between Aker BP, Subsea7 and
    OneSubsea.

*******************************************************************************

Subsea7 is a global leader in the delivery of offshore projects and services for

partner and employer of choice in delivering the efficient offshore solutions
